svg.title: SVI housing price: compare three inputs on the same homes
svg.desc: Coordinate-named local Street View images join a housing table at latitude and longitude. One held-out split supports tabular-only, image-only, and combined gradient boosting models. Compare their MAE and scatterplots; this does not infer a causal effect of visual quality.
svg.text: SVI housing price: compare three inputs on the same homes
Image-only uses eight offline colour/edge statistics by default, not subjective perception scores.
lat / lon in filename ↔ housing CSV
The same row enters three model inputs
Lower MAE is better on these held-out rows; points near the scatterplot diagonal have smaller errors.
A street scene may correlate with housing prices, but these features do not measure cleanliness or a causal effect.
